You must make your appeal request within 65 calendar days from the date on the written notice. [1][2]
For a standard appeal, you can submit your request in writing or by calling the plan. [1]
For a fast appeal, you can submit your request in writing or by calling the plan. [1]
If you miss the appeal deadline, you can explain the reason for the delay, and the plan may grant more time. [1]
You can ask for a copy of the information regarding your medical decision and add more information to support your appeal. [1]

A grievance is also called a complaint. [1]
Filing a grievance is the process of making a complaint. [1]
An expedited grievance is a fast complaint. [1]
To file a grievance, you can contact Member Services by phone at 1-888-778-1478 or TTY 711. [1]
You can also file a grievance in writing and Clover Health will respond in writing. [1]
A representative can file a grievance on your behalf if they have legal authorization or complete an Appointment of Representative form. [1]
The grievance process is used for problems like quality of care, waiting times, and customer service. [2]
Examples of grievances include issues with privacy, disrespect, poor customer service, or delays in getting appointments. [2]

You can see out-of-network providers, but your share of costs may be higher unless it's for emergency care, urgently needed services, or out-of-area dialysis. [1]

If an out-of-network provider bills you, you can ask the plan to reimburse you for its share of the cost. [1]
